_readme: The Arabic poetry shown on the landing page.
Each entry in 'verses' is one بيت: [صدر, عجز]. They render side by side on a
wide screen and stack on a phone, the way Arabic verse is normally set.
'author' is optional — leave it empty to hide the credit.
To hide the whole section, set "verses": []
verses: تَغَرَّبْ عَنِ الأوطانِ في طَلَبِ العُلا
فإنْ قيلَ في الأسفارِ ذُلٌّ ومِحنَةٌ
فمَوتُ الفَتى خَيرٌ لهُ مِن حَياتِهِ
author: الإمام الشافعي
